method: Largest box IoU within the same page and sheet. Oracle boxes are padded, so overlaps alone do not imply a tie. Multi-character sources are retained as unresolved multi-glyph joins, not assigned an arbitrary single oracle. Exact ties are ambiguous. Single-best is a liberal upper bound on reliable single-glyph joins; weak overlaps and small margins are separately counted.
bbox_coordinate_check: Source boxes directly overlap native-DPI oracle boxes without rescaling; per-sheet IoUs are reported.
